boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Skidmore College
boards.description: Late-hour food and study destinations with current official hours; campus schedules can vary during breaks and holidays.

cards.title: Murray-Aikins late night
cards.subtitle: Skidmore College campus
cards.notes: Head to the dining hall Sunday through Thursday after 8 p.m.; the late-night menu runs until 10 p.m. during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus late meal option with a defined nightly service window.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore lists late-night service at Murray-Aikins from 8–10 p.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Academic-year late-night service: Sunday–Thursday, 8–10 p.m.; schedules may change during breaks.

cards.title: The Spa late-night grill
cards.subtitle: Skidmore College campus
cards.notes: Plan this for Friday or Saturday: The Spa reopens from 10 p.m. to 1 a.m. during the academic calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore lists The Spa open Friday and Saturday from 10 p.m. to 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday late-night service is listed as 10 p.m.–1 a.m. during the academic calendar.

cards.title: Atrium Café evening stop
cards.subtitle: Skidmore College campus
cards.notes: Use the Atrium Café for an evening food stop; regular hours run until 10 p.m. Monday through Thursday and on Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A campus café that remains open into the evening on several days.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore lists Atrium Café hours until 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Regular hours: Monday–Thursday and Sunday until 10 p.m.; Friday and Saturday close at 8 p.m.

cards.title: Lucy Scribner Library reset
cards.subtitle: Skidmore College campus
cards.notes: Bring a study task or a book for a late campus reset; regular Sunday–Thursday library hours extend until 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A late-open campus destination when the run is for focus rather than food.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists regular fall and spring semester hours until 1 a.m. Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Regular fall/spring hours: Sunday–Thursday until 1 a.m.; actual hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Congress Street
cards.subtitle: 24 Congress St, Saratoga Springs
cards.notes: For a downtown food run, use the Congress Street location’s listed dine-in, carryout, delivery, or drive-thru service until 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A downtown chain restaurant with the board’s latest listed closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours at 24 Congress Street until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are listed as 10 a.m.–3 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Route 50
cards.subtitle: 3075 Route 50, Saratoga Springs
cards.notes: Use the Route 50 Wendy’s when traveling north of downtown; its official Saratoga listing identifies it as open until 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A second late-open Wendy’s location on the Route 50 corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official Saratoga Springs location listing shows 3075 Route 50 open until 1 a.m.
cards.source_title: Wendy's Locations in Saratoga Springs, New York
cards.access_notes: The official city listing shows this location open until 1 a.m.; confirm same-day holiday hours before leaving.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Route 50
cards.subtitle: 3012 Route 50, Saratoga Springs
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a late takeout stop; the official location page lists it open until 1 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Route 50 drive-thru with consistent listed late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 3012 Route 50 as 9 a.m.–1 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru hours are listed as 9 a.m.–1 a.m. daily; the dine-in room closes earlier.

cards.title: 7-Eleven on Route 50
cards.subtitle: 3009 Rt 50, Saratoga Springs
cards.notes: Keep this convenience stop in reserve for any-hour essentials; its official page identifies the store as open 24 hours a day.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 Route 50 stop for food and convenience items.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven lists its 3009 Rt 50 Saratoga Springs store as open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists the store as open 24/7.

cards.title: Pizza 7 on Caroline Street
cards.subtitle: 7 Caroline St, Saratoga Springs
cards.notes: Check the ordering page before heading downtown; Pizza 7 says it is open daily from 11 a.m. into late night for dine-in, takeout, or delivery.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizzeria that explicitly advertises daily late-night availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza 7’s official site states it is open every day from 11 a.m. to late night.
cards.access_notes: Official site says “Open Everyday 11am to Late night”; it does not state a specific closing time, so confirm before travel.

cards.title: Domino’s on Washington Street
cards.subtitle: 86 Washington St, Saratoga Springs
cards.notes: Use the official location page to start a carryout or delivery order, then check the live Hours section before setting out for the store.
cards.short_summary: A Saratoga Springs pizza location offering carryout and delivery ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s identifies its Saratoga Springs location at 86 Washington Street and offers carryout and delivery ordering there.
cards.access_notes: The official page directs visitors to its live Hours section for up-to-date store hours; verify the closing time before going.
